info.title: SCRIPTORIUM API
info.description: Historical Document Intelligence Platform — REST API. All recognition runs on institution-controlled Kraken infrastructure; no document is sent to third-party AI services.

schema.title: Response My Sessions Api V1 Me Sessions Get
Response List Users Api V1 Admin Users Get
Response List Institutions Api V1 Institutions Get
Response List Members Api V1 Institutions  Institution Id  Members Get

get.description: Policy and effective limits for members; usage figures for institution administrators.

schema.title: Response List Projects Api V1 Projects Get
Response List Project Members Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Members Get
Response List Collections Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Collections Get

post.description: Upload one or more files. Each file becomes a document; pages are extracted in the background.

schema.title: Response Upload Documents Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Collections  Collection Id  Documents Post
Response List Documents Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Collections  Collection Id  Documents Get

get.description: Signed, time-limited asset delivery (URLs are issued only to authorised users).

schema.title: Response List Models Api V1 Models Get
Response List Jobs Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Recognition Jobs Get
Response Page Segmentations Api V1 Pages  Page Id  Segmentations Get

post.description:
Save an adjusted segmentation as a NEW segmentation (the parent is never modified).
Lines without a boundary polygon get one computed by Kraken when recognition runs.

schema.title: Response Page Recognitions Api V1 Pages  Page Id  Recognitions Get

post.description: Pin a version / roll back to an earlier validated version.
Validate and render a line of editorial markup (used by the editor while typing).

Score one recognition against one ground-truth page (line-aligned when the segmentation is the
ground truth's, page-level otherwise). Optionally store the result.

get.description:
Full traceability record: source document and page, image checksums, segmentation, model
(Zenodo DOI, checksum, licence), Kraken version, processing configuration, editorial history.

post.description: Kraken / eScriptorium-ready PAGE XML (line polygons, baselines, reference text) of every split.

Manual registration of a Kraken model file (.mlmodel CoreML or .safetensors weights).
The file is stored, checksummed and then loaded by Kraken on the models worker before it can be used.
(Synchronous handler: disk writes and the malware scan run in the threadpool, not on the event loop.)

get.description: Weights of a model owned by this project, for its members (export permission).

post.description: The PI confirms that every listed author agreed; the package is then generated.
Record the DOI after a person published the approved package on Zenodo.

get.description:
W3C Web Annotation Data Model collection (JSON-LD). Targets: the page image region of the
annotated line (media-fragment `xywh`) on the platform's IIIF canvas of that page.
Error analysis of stored line-aligned evaluation results (latest result per page and model).

IIIF Presentation 3.0 manifest. Image URLs are signed and expire (default 1 h): the manifest is
meant for authenticated use and for exchange of structure and text, not as a public image service.

post.description: Dry run by default (`apply=false`): reports what the retention policy would remove.

get.description: Security-relevant configuration, for institutional deployment reviews (no secrets disclosed).

files.title: Files

basis.title: Basis

DashboardOut.title: DashboardOut
DashboardOut.description:
Every figure is a COUNT over database rows visible to the user.
Metrics belonging to modules that are not yet installed are reported as null
together with the module name in `unavailable`.

Deskew.title: Deskew
Deskew.description: Estimate the skew angle by projection-profile analysis and rotate it away.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Zenodo DOI, record URL or record id

confidence_note.title: Confidence Note
confidence_note.default: mean_confidence is the average of per-character softmax maxima reported by the model; it is NOT a calibrated probability nor a measured accuracy.

Rotate.title: Rotate
Rotate.description: Rotation correction by an explicit angle (degrees, counter-clockwise).
